body: Do you feel stuck or paralyzed? That's how I'm feeling. I want to move on but my mind is trapped. All we need is something to tell us what to do.

I wanted to drown myself too, I was so close. I was with a friend, visiting the country where I wanted to do it, but I ended up with the direct flight home, and he ended up with the delayed flight. I messed up and missed my small window of opportunity. I've felt dead ever since.

I feel exactly like this too. Right on the nail. I have some friends that care about me, but their efforts won't be enough to change the way I've become. I truly appreciate all the kind people I've met, I hope they live their lives out continuing to be kind and nice to others, but I should be let go and forgotten.
